aka.zh: 小草湖至和田高速公路

tagline.en: Southern Xinjiang's trunk road: over the Tianshan from the Turpan basin and round the northern and western rim of the Tarim to Hotan, built in pieces from 2005 to 2019
tagline.zh: 南疆的主干道：自吐鲁番盆地翻越天山，沿塔里木盆地北缘和西缘直抵和田，2005 年至 2019 年分段建成

start.en: South of Yengisar, Kashgar Prefecture, where the drawn line ends. The road continues south-east by Shache, Yecheng, Pishan and Moyu to Hotan and the Luopu East interchange, where it meets G0612
start.zh: 喀什地区英吉沙县以南，所绘线段止于此。道路继续向东南经莎车、叶城、皮山、墨玉至和田，在洛浦东互通与 G0612 相接

end.en: Xiaocaohu interchange with G30 Lianyungang–Khorgas Expressway, Toksun County, Turpan — kilometre 0
end.zh: 吐鲁番市托克逊县小草湖立交，与 G30 连霍高速相接——零公里点

en: G3012 is a spur of G30, the Lianyungang–Khorgas Expressway, and lies wholly within Xinjiang. It leaves G30 at Xiaocaohu, west of Turpan, runs south through Toksun and over the eastern Tianshan to Hoxud and the Yanqi basin, then on to Korla. From there it follows the old National Road 314 west along the northern edge of the Tarim basin through Luntai, Kuqa, Xinhe and Aksu, and on by Kalpin, Bachu and Artux to Kashgar. From Kashgar it turns south-east along National Road 315 through Shule, Yengisar, Shache, Zepu, Yecheng, Pishan and Moyu to Hotan, ending at Luopu East, where G0612 continues east along the south of the Taklamakan.

Chinese Wikipedia gives its length as 1,931 km. The same article gives two ends: its infobox puts the end in Qira County, but its junction list stops at Luopu East. A 2017 report carried by Xinjiang's transport department said that once the Kashgar sections were finished, the 1,800-odd km from Urumqi to Hotan, by G30 to Xiaocaohu and then this road, could be driven on expressway all the way. The atlas draws it in two pieces. This page is anchored on the long one, from Xiaocaohu to south of Yengisar; the second is a short stretch near Yecheng.
zh: G3012 是 G30 连霍高速的联络线，全线位于新疆境内。它在吐鲁番以西的小草湖离开 G30，向南经托克逊翻越天山东段，到和硕和焉耆盆地，再至库尔勒；此后沿原 314 国道走向，沿塔里木盆地北缘向西，经轮台、库车、新和、阿克苏，再经柯坪、巴楚、阿图什抵喀什；自喀什折向东南，沿 315 国道走向经疏勒、英吉沙、莎车、泽普、叶城、皮山、墨玉至和田，止于洛浦东，由 G0612 沿塔克拉玛干沙漠南缘继续向东。
据中文维基百科，全长 1,931 公里。该条目对终点的说法前后不一：信息框作和田地区策勒县，互通列表则止于洛浦东。2017 年新疆维吾尔自治区交通运输厅网站转载的报道称，喀什附近各段建成后，从乌鲁木齐经 G30 至小草湖、再走这条路到和田，1,800 多公里可实现全程高速。地图把它画成两段；本页定位在较长的一段，即小草湖至英吉沙以南，另一段是叶城附近的一小段。

en: The Tianshan crossing between Toksun and Hoxud is a divided road on a large scale: one carriageway climbs through the Wohubulak gully and the other through the Gangou gully. This 235.68 km Xiaocaohu–Hoxud section was rebuilt in 2011–2012. Xinjiang Net called it an upgrade from class-I highway to expressway, but another report of its opening describes it as a class-I road, so its standard is not settled here. Both reports called it the main road between northern and southern Xinjiang, and the only one open all year.

Hoxud–Korla, 92.45 km across the Yanqi basin, was southern Xinjiang's first expressway. According to the Urumqi Evening News, 57 km of it needed soft-ground treatment, and the Huangshuigou bridge was the first in Xinjiang where a bridge-erecting machine was used to place its 70-tonne beams. Kuqa–Aksu, about 260 km, was Xinjiang's first road built under a single design-and-build contract. That contract went to China Communications Construction, and at the time it was the longest road in China built that way.

At Kashgar the 43.76 km Kashgar–Shule section serves as an eastern bypass of the city. The Tianshan Net said it cut the transit of Kashgar from two hours to twenty-odd minutes. The section from Shule to Moyu was first built as the Kashgar–Yecheng road, opened in 2012, of which 153 km was expressway and 84 km a class-II road. It was rebuilt as the 434.314 km Kashgar–Yecheng–Moyu phase two, four lanes designed for 120 km/h, and 100 km/h where the earlier road was reused.
zh: 托克逊至和硕之间翻越天山的一段，上下行大幅分离：一幅沿卧虎不拉沟翻越天山，另一幅沿甘沟翻越天山。这段小草湖至和硕公路全长 235.68 公里，2011—2012 年改建。新疆网称其为“一级改高速”项目，另一篇通车报道则称其为一级公路，此处不作定论。两篇报道都称它是连接南北疆最主要、也是唯一能常年通车的公路通道。
横穿焉耆盆地的和硕至库尔勒段 92.45 公里，是南疆第一条高速公路。据《乌鲁木齐晚报》报道，全线有 57 公里软弱地基需要处理；黄水沟大桥施工中在新疆首次使用架桥机架设 70 吨大梁。库车至阿克苏段约 260 公里，是新疆第一个采用设计施工总承包模式建设的公路项目，由中国交通建设集团承建，也是当时全国路线最长的采用这一模式建设的高速公路。
在喀什，43.76 公里的喀什至疏勒段兼作喀什市东绕城，天山网称过境喀什的车程由 2 小时缩短至 20 多分钟。疏勒至墨玉一段最初作为喀什至叶城公路修建，2012 年通车，其中高速公路 153 公里、二级公路 84 公里；后来由全长 434.314 公里的喀叶墨高速公路二期工程改建，双向四车道，设计时速 120 公里，利用原路的路段为 100 公里。

en: The expressway began in the middle. Hoxud–Korla opened throughout on trial on 18 October 2005, ending, as China National Radio put it, southern Xinjiang's years without an expressway. Korla–Kuqa, 299.71 km, was begun in October 2008 and opened in May 2011. Kuqa–Aksu was begun in 2010 and opened on 9 December 2011, a year ahead of schedule. Kashgar Prefecture got its first expressway when Kashgar–Yecheng opened on 20 February 2012. Xiaocaohu–Hoxud, built under the management of Tianjin's municipal highway bureau, opened on 25 October 2012; it was the first project to open under the national programme in which 14 provinces and cities supported road building in Xinjiang.
Aksu–Kashgar, 429.1 km, was begun in 2012 and opened in July 2015. It joined the northern and western stretches into one expressway from Korla to Kashgar.

Hotan came last. Moyu–Hotan, 74 km, was begun in March 2015 and opened on 1 August 2018 as Hotan Prefecture's first expressway. The Kashgar–Shule bypass was handed over in October 2018. The rebuilt Kashgar–Yecheng–Moyu section, begun in July 2017, opened on 31 July 2019, nearly a year early. Xinjiang's transport department said that from that day every prefecture and city in the region was linked by expressway, and that Xinjiang's expressways passed 5,000 km.
zh: 这条高速公路是从中间修起的。和硕至库尔勒段于 2005 年 10 月 18 日全线试通车，用中央人民广播电台的话说，南疆从此结束了不通高速公路的历史。库尔勒至库车段 299.71 公里，2008 年 10 月开工，2011 年 5 月建成通车。库车至阿克苏段 2010 年开工，2011 年 12 月 9 日通车，提前一年。喀什至叶城段 2012 年 2 月 20 日通车，喀什地区有了第一条高速公路。由天津市市政公路管理局组织代建的小草湖至和硕段于 2012 年 10 月 25 日建成通车，是全国 14 个省、自治区、直辖市支持新疆公路建设工程中首个建成通车的项目。
阿克苏至喀什段 429.1 公里，2012 年开工，2015 年 7 月通车，北缘与西缘由此连成一条自库尔勒直达喀什的高速公路。

和田最后接通。墨玉至和田段 74 公里，2015 年 3 月开工，2018 年 8 月 1 日通车，是和田地区第一条高速公路。喀什至疏勒绕城段 2018 年 10 月交工。改建后的喀什（疏勒）至叶城至墨玉段 2017 年 7 月开工，2019 年 7 月 31 日通车，比合同工期提前近一年。新疆维吾尔自治区交通运输厅称，至此全疆所有地州市实现高速公路连通，新疆高速公路通车里程超过 5,000 公里。

en: No total has been published. G3012 was built as about nine separately approved projects over fifteen years, and their costs differ widely. At the cheap end, the Xiaocaohu–Hoxud rebuild was reported at ¥596 million for 235.68 km. Hoxud–Korla cost ¥2.43 billion, Korla–Kuqa ¥4.105 billion and Kuqa–Aksu ¥6.491 billion by its approved estimate. Aksu–Kashgar, the longest single project, cost ¥12.3 billion. On the Kashgar–Hotan side, Kashgar–Yecheng (2012) cost ¥3.64 billion, the Kashgar–Shule bypass was estimated at ¥2.439 billion, Moyu–Hotan cost ¥2.87 billion, and the Kashgar–Yecheng–Moyu rebuild was reported at ¥8.5 billion. The Aksu prefecture transport bureau put the three sections across its territory, Korla to Kashgar, at ¥22.9 billion together.

The one approval that sets out who paid is for the Kashgar–Shule bypass. The National Development and Reform Commission allotted ¥1.25 billion from the central special construction fund (vehicle purchase tax) as the project's capital, about 51 per cent, with the rest borrowed from domestic banks. Chinese Wikipedia's junction list marks several stretches as toll-free, among them Xiaocaohu to Hoxud.
zh: 全线没有公开的总造价。G3012 在十五年间分约九个项目分别审批建设，各段造价相差悬殊。最便宜的是小草湖至和硕段改建，报道称 235.68 公里总投资 5.96 亿元；和硕至库尔勒段 24.3 亿元，库尔勒至库车段 41.05 亿元，库车至阿克苏段概算 64.91 亿元；单个项目中最长的阿克苏至喀什段 123 亿元。喀什至和田一侧，2012 年的喀什至叶城段 36.4 亿元，喀什至疏勒绕城段估算 24.39 亿元，墨玉至和田段 28.7 亿元，喀叶墨改建工程报道为 85 亿元。阿克苏地区交通运输局称，境内库尔勒至喀什的三段合计总投资 229 亿元。
唯一公开了资金构成的批复是喀什至疏勒段：国家发展和改革委员会安排中央专项建设基金（车购税）12.5 亿元作为项目资本金，约占总投资的 51%，其余利用国内银行贷款解决。中文维基百科的互通列表把若干路段标为免费路段，其中包括小草湖至和硕段。

en: Journey times fell section by section. Kuqa–Aksu took the drive from four hours to just over two, and Aksu–Kashgar saved more than two hours. Korla–Kuqa took about three hours, some two hours less than before. The head of a Xinjiang logistics firm said in 2019 that his lorries from Kashgar to Hotan had taken nearly eight hours and now took five. When Kashgar–Yecheng opened on trial in 2012, with its roadside facilities unfinished, it was limited to 80 km/h.

Chinese Wikipedia's junction list marks a number of service areas where traffic must pull in for police checks, among them Hoxud, Xinhe, Jiamu, Aqia, Sanchakou and Artux; at Aqia and Sanchakou this applies in both directions.
zh: 车程随着各段通车逐段缩短：库车至阿克苏由四个小时缩短为两个多小时，阿克苏至喀什节省 2 个小时以上，库尔勒至库车约 3 小时可达，比原来缩短约 2 小时。2019 年，新疆一家物流企业负责人说，货物从喀什运到和田，此前全程需要近 8 个小时，走高速 5 个小时就能到。喀什至叶城段 2012 年试通车时道路设施尚不完善，限速每小时 80 公里。
中文维基百科的互通列表标出若干服务区，车辆必须驶入接受公安检查，包括和硕、新和、佳木、阿恰、三岔口、阿图什等处；阿恰与三岔口为双向检查。

why.en: No route-wide figure is published. G3012 was built from 2002 to 2019 as about nine separately approved and financed projects, each accounted for on its own; the published section costs are listed separately below.
why.zh: 未公布全线总造价。G3012 于 2002 年至 2019 年间分约九个项目分别审批、筹资和核算；已公布的路段造价另列如下。

value.en: Published only for the Kashgar–Shule bypass: ¥1.25 billion from the central special construction fund (vehicle purchase tax) as capital, about 51 per cent of the estimate, the rest domestic bank loans. Xiaocaohu–Hoxud was built under the management of Tianjin's municipal highway bureau as part of the national programme supporting road building in Xinjiang; who paid for it, and for the other sections, has not been found.
value.zh: 仅喀什至疏勒段公布了资金构成：中央专项建设基金（车购税）12.5 亿元作为资本金，约占估算总投资的 51%，其余为国内银行贷款。小草湖至和硕段由天津市市政公路管理局作为全国支持新疆公路建设工程项目组织代建；该段及其余路段由谁出资，未查到。

timeline.en: Hoxud–Korla, southern Xinjiang's first expressway, opens on trial on 18 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 18 日，南疆首条高速公路和硕至库尔勒段全线试通车。

timeline.en: Work on Korla–Kuqa begins in October.
timeline.zh: 10 月，库尔勒至库车段开工。

timeline.en: Korla–Kuqa opens in May; Kuqa–Aksu opens on 9 December.
timeline.zh: 5 月，库尔勒至库车段通车；12 月 9 日，库车至阿克苏段通车。

timeline.en: Kashgar–Yecheng opens on 20 February; Xiaocaohu–Hoxud, over the Tianshan, opens on 25 October.
timeline.zh: 2 月 20 日，喀什至叶城段通车；10 月 25 日，翻越天山的小草湖至和硕段建成通车。

timeline.en: Aksu–Kashgar opens in July; work begins on Moyu–Hotan in March and on the Kashgar–Shule bypass in December.
timeline.zh: 7 月，阿克苏至喀什段通车；3 月墨玉至和田段、12 月喀什至疏勒段相继开工。

timeline.en: The Kashgar–Yecheng–Moyu rebuild begins in July.
timeline.zh: 7 月，喀叶墨高速公路二期工程开工。

timeline.en: Moyu–Hotan, Hotan Prefecture's first expressway, opens on 1 August; the Kashgar–Shule bypass is handed over in October.
timeline.zh: 8 月 1 日，和田地区第一条高速公路墨玉至和田段通车；10 月，喀什至疏勒段交工。

timeline.en: Kashgar–Yecheng–Moyu opens on 31 July, linking Hotan to the rest of Xinjiang's expressways.
timeline.zh: 7 月 31 日，喀叶墨高速公路通车，和田接入新疆高速公路网。
